Watering.title: Watering
Watering.description: A visitor's unique one-time watering interaction on the root garden, keyed by lowercase X handle (without @).

xHandle.description: The visitor's X handle normalized with a leading @ symbol.

xHandleLower.description: Lowercase version of the visitor's X handle matching '@' + wateringId.

followed.description: Whether the owner has already followed this visitor back on X.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the visitor watered the plant.

followedAt.description: Server timestamp when the owner marked the visitor as followed.

GardenStats.title: GardenStats
GardenStats.description: Public aggregate counter of unique waterings in the root garden.

totalWaterings.description: Total number of unique friends who have watered the root plant.

lastWateringId.description: Document ID (lowercase handle without @) of the most recent Watering committed atomically with this stats update.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest watering.

UserGarden.title: UserGarden
UserGarden.description: A user-claimed seedling garden with its own shareable URL (?g=<handle>), botanical species, and aggregate watering count.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who claimed this seedling.

ownerHandle.description: Seedling owner's X handle normalized with @.

seedlingType.description: Botanical species chosen by the seedling owner.

totalWaterings.description: Total number of unique visitors who watered this seedling.

lastWateringId.description: Most recent visitor handle ID (or empty string on creation).

GardenWatering.title: GardenWatering
GardenWatering.description: A visitor's unique one-time watering on a specific user-claimed seedling garden.

gardenOwnerUid.description: Owner UID copied from parent UserGarden for O(1) secure list queries.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Admin role marker document for delegated garden owners.

/waterings/{wateringId}.description: Root garden waterings keyed by lowercase handle without @.

/gardens/{gardenId}.description: User-claimed personal seedling gardens keyed by lowercase owner X handle without @.

/gardens/{gardenId}/waterings/{visitorHa.description: Unique visitor waterings on a user-claimed seedling garden, readable only by that garden's ownerUid.

/admins/{uid}.description: Optional delegated admin documents; read-only for the owner.
